text:
Maria G.: heads up — ran into a weird combo in the NextKit LlamaStarter sample on edge runtime. Typescript exports for the prompt templates aren't visible when you import from the cjs build.
Jonah H.: ugh that sounds like our build targets. Is this the new typed-eval example or the old one?
Maria G.: typed-eval example (the one with the eval harness + tiny langchain wiring). repro steps: `pnpm install && pnpm dev`, open /examples/typed-eval, then in browser console we get `TypeError: Cannot read property 'render' of undefined` on import.
Devon (devex): can you paste the import line? maybe it's `module.exports` vs `export default` mismatch.
Maria G.: import is `import { BasicPrompt } from '@redwood/llamastarter/prompts'` — the built lib emits `exports.BasicPrompt = ...` but TS types generated point at `src/` structure and vscode resolves to `index.d.ts` that doesn't match.
Jonah H.: hmm, sounds like our rollup/bundler config for the edge target missed `preserveModules: true` or the `exports` field. We changed that recently for the SSE streaming patch.
Samir: related note — I also saw flaky auth tokens when running the example on edge functions. After 60s the ephemeral key rotation fails in the browser because the serverless cold-start delays the refresh. End result: eval harness gets 401 mid-stream.
Maria G.: yes that's the auth behavior I hit too. The sample's helper `withRedwoodAuth()` currently assumes sync refresh which breaks with edge background refresh.
Devon (devex): quick mitigation: bump the sample to use refresh-on-start + optimistic retry (2x) in the SDK call wrapper. Not ideal but will reduce hits for demo.
Jonah H.: SDK parity note: our Node SDK does streaming + reconnect automatically, browser SDK currently throws on 401 mid-stream. That divergence is hurting the sample since typed-eval uses streaming outputs.
Samir: filed a short repro in CI — ci-bot: see run 342 for failing e2e on /examples/typed-eval.
ci-bot: test run 342 failed — error at examples/typed-eval/e2e/stream.spec.ts line 27: expected stream to resume but got 401
Maria G.: proposed changes: 1) adjust build to export ESM + CJS with aligned d.ts, 2) in sample add robust auth wrapper that retries token refresh and falls back to non-streaming mode with a warning, 3) update README to call out edge cold-start caveat.
Jonah H.: agree, prioritise (1) and (2) — smallest patch that unblocks DX. I can take the build tweak.
Devon (devex): I'll do the sample auth wrapper and update the example harness to optionally run in non-stream mode for CI.
Samir: I'll add a flaky tag to the CI test and push a short-lived skip until the fixes land.
Maria G.: thanks! small follow-up: should we add a tiny integration test that runs the example in an emulated edge (wrangler/mini) to catch this going forward?
Jonah H.: yes please — start with a unit test for the export surface, then an integration smoke that asserts the stream doesn't throw on auth refresh.
Devon (devex): will draft PRs: build tweak (jonah/edge-exports), sample wrapper + readme (devon/typed-eval-auth), ci skip + test (samir/ci-typed-eval).
Maria G.: awesome. tagging @devex to triage the docs update after PRs land. thanks all :thumbsup:
Samir: thanks — I'll drop the ci skip and re-enable once both PRs merged.
Jonah H.: ETA: build PR later today.
Devon (devex): ETA sample PR tomorrow morning PST.
Maria G.: closing the loop here — leaving a short checklist in the example dir.
